title: Product of Array Except Self - Solution
approach: Accumulate products from left to right, then right to left in a single result array.
intuition: Given an integer array nums, return an array answer such that answer[i] is equal to the product of all the elements of nums except nums[i]. Solve without division.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
optimized_approach: Accumulate products from left to right, then right to left in a single result array.
code:
def solution(nums):
    n = len(nums)
    res = [1] * n
    prefix = 1
    for i in range(n):
        res[i] = prefix
        prefix *= nums[i]
    suffix = 1
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        res[i] *= suffix
        suffix *= nums[i]
    return res
common_mistakes: Calculate prefix products and suffix products separately.
